copy.curiosityHook: Can two clashing researchers unlock a life-saving medical secret before approaching machinery tears down the rainforest canopy around them?
copy.description: Deep in the Amazon, an eccentric scientist rejects his new female research assistant, but the pair must set friction aside when approaching bulldozers jeopardize their search for a breakthrough cancer cure.
copy.vibeSummary: An earnest, medium-paced romantic adventure with moderate emotional weight and steady visual atmosphere, built for engaged date-night viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director John McTiernan pairs remote jungle adventure with romantic drama, turning a fraught medical race into an engaging two-hander charged with high environmental stakes.

allowedMaterial: eccentric scientist and female research assistant dynamic
excludedMaterial: fate of the rainforest and confrontation with bulldozers
